com.esignal.jstandard.event

Class SymbolEvent

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.util.EventObject
      • com.esignal.jstandard.event.StatusEvent
        • com.esignal.jstandard.event.SymbolEvent
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    TurnAroundAware, java.io.Serializable
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    BarEvent, MarketDepthEvent, MarketDepthInfoEvent, NetOrderImbalanceEvent, OptionMonthsEvent, QuoteEvent, StockOptionRootsEvent, TickEvent

    public abstract class SymbolEvent
extends StatusEvent
    Purpose of this event is to work as a base event which returns back data to the client for a given symbol. All the events that provides data should extend this class and start providing symbol information for which the event has been triggered.
    Since:
    01-001-0010
    Author:
    Interactive Data Corporation
